claims: Clash Royale is a free-to-play real-time multiplayer PvP strategy game.
Clash Royale was developed by Supercell.
Clash Royale is available on Android and Windows via the Google Play Store.
Clash Royale is available on Google Play for Android and PC.
Players battle by placing cards to destroy enemy towers in Clash Royale.
Clash Royale features various leagues.
Clash Royale features clan-based gameplay.
Players build a battle deck of 8 cards in Clash Royale.
Battle deck cards in Clash Royale consist of troops, spells, and defenses.
Players use elixir to deploy cards in Clash Royale.
Players aim to destroy the opponent's King Tower in Clash Royale.
Clash Royale battles occur within 3 minutes.
Joining a clan in Clash Royale allows sharing cards.
Joining a clan in Clash Royale allows participating in clan wars for large rewards.
Joining a clan allows playing in Clan Wars in Clash Royale.
Players compete to win trophies in Clash Royale.
Players move up through various Arenas in Clash Royale.
Players move into competitive leagues in Clash Royale.
Clash Royale features Global Tournaments.
Clash Royale features regular seasonal updates.
Clash Royale updates occur often monthly.
Clash Royale updates add new evolutions.
Clash Royale updates add new cards.
Clash Royale updates add new heroes.
Clash of Clans is available on Apple iOS.
